description: Public baseline for tests/postgres-caller.spec.ts: every caller/reviewer domain case above the "Delegated admission boundaries" marker, with its it.each parameters and minimum expect() count. Authored in PR #1 (2026-11-08) as an explicit public contract that replaces a private qualification snapshot; it is NOT a copy or reconstruction of that snapshot. Update it only when intentionally changing a pre-boundary case.
